priceSources.heading: Price sources
priceSources.on: Automatic prices are on. The sources in use, in order:
priceSources.noBond: Bonds have no automatic source yet; use manual prices.

page.intro: Turn the price sources on and off, choose their order and the exchanges you prefer, and start an update.
page.offNotice: Automatic prices are off on this installation (PT_MARKET_DATA): no source is asked. What you change here is saved and applies when they are turned on.
page.nextUpdate: Changes apply from the next update. Each change is recorded in the audit log.
page.runQueued: Update started. New prices arrive over the next minutes.
page.runAlreadyQueued: An update is already waiting to start.
page.runRunning: An update is in progress: try again when it ends.
page.runOff: Automatic prices are off on this installation, so no update can start.
page.ordersNote: The first source that is on is asked first. A source that is off keeps its place and is skipped.
page.noEngine: No source: nothing is asked for this use.
page.orderStale: This order holds a source that this version does not have: remove it first.
page.exchangesNote: Where a security trades on several exchanges, the first one listed here that has it gives the price.
page.noExchanges: No preference: the main exchanges trading in the security's currency come first.
page.exchangeHint: The code the source uses, for example GER for Xetra or MIL for Milan.
page.addedExchange: {{name}} added to the preferred exchanges at position {{position}}.
page.movedExchange: {{name}}: position {{position}} of {{count}} in the preferred exchanges.

exchangeProblems.comma: An exchange code cannot hold a comma.
exchangeProblems.repeat: This exchange is already in the list.

page.exchangeRefused: The server refused this exchange: check its code.
page.confirmText: After this change no source is on for:

confirmRoles.ETF_STOCK: ETFs and stocks: their prices are no longer updated.
confirmRoles.FX: Exchange rates: they are no longer updated.
confirmRoles.CLASSIFY: Security type: new securities are not recognised, so they never get automatic prices.

page.confirmNothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted: the stored prices stay, and you can turn a source back on here.
